text.4:82: Will they not then ponder on the Qur'an? If it had been from other than Allah they would have found therein much incongruity.
text.23:68: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
text.38:29: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
text.47:24: Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts?
